Savory Bites with a Sweet Finish
Jul 2026 • Solo
The assorted spring rolls were savory and soft, and the accompanying sauces complemented them nicely. The assorted steamed dumplings were also soft, though I felt the filling-to-wrapper ratio could have been more generous. The deep-fried spring rolls, fried ravioli, and shrimp toast were savory and satisfying without being oily. The shrimp vermicelli soup had a light, clear broth. It was a hearty bowl, and the portion size was just right. The gourmet desserts were not very sweet and provided a nice ending to the entire dining experience.

A gem of French-Vietnamese fusion cuisine
Sep 2025 • Friends
We discovered Dong Pho by accident after going to a nearby restaurant with expat friends working in HCMC. And went twice in a row as it was so incredibly good !! . The menu is almost overwhelming but the restaurant manager did a great job helping us narrow our choices. Food presentation is very appealing but what really tops it up is the quality of the food. All dishes are freshly cooked, deliciously fragrant yet light and delicate! If French influence is evident (the owner studied French cuisine we read) , it is the combination of French and Vietnamese cuisine that makes this place special. We like the fact that customers are a balanced mix of locals, expats living in VN and a few tourists like us. A great food /wine experience at very reasonable prices ! Highly recommend.

Disappointed
Dec 2023 • Friends
I have been at Đồng Phố several times in the past and used to love Hue food at this restaurant. I was excited when my cousins suggested this restaurant. So we reserved a table for 7. The restaurant still looked nice and cozy. The services were fine as my cousins dines there frequently.

We ordered several dishes and after tasting some of them, I was disappointed that the food was not as good as they used to be. Most dishes were average but the Bun Bo soup was totally bland and did not taste like the authentic Bun Bo soup any more!!!

The price was expensive even though we got some discounts. 

I would love to give this restaurant another try next time I visit Saigon. Hopefully the chef will improve the food and the price is more reasonable by then.

Beautiful food but really poor service, and bad attitude by management
Dec 2022 • Couples
Beautiful food but really poor service, and bad attitude by management (French owners?). 
Never in all my years have I had such a bad experienced and I don’t like to write bad reviews but I’m just being honest. 

Booked this restaurant based on the hundreds of glowing reviews online. 
Arrived at the time we book but the staff already seemed frazzled and confused - not a great sign but we got seated. 

Huge menu with wide selection of dishes. 
We ordered, and the food arrived really fast. 
No wine list when we asked - they just asked if we preferred white or red. That was it , and two glasses arrived, no idea what variety of wine it was and he was gone before we could ask. 
Food was all delicious and fresh, and we were very happy. 
But then the service just suddenly stopped all together - staff were blatantly ignoring us! Ironically this was as tables started leaving, so service should have improved if anything.
We eventually caught the attention of a staff member and asked for a dessert menu which they brought. And then waited another 10 minutes but again we were being ignored by every staff member again. Couldn’t even get the bill ! 
So we decided to walk to the counter and pay & leave as we were clearly not made to feel welcome anymore. 
Well, management were clueless with regards to the table bills and quite frankly didn’t really give a damn about anything. 
Incredibly bad attitude. 
We then wanted to pay with a contactless credit card on my mobile phone but they just pretended they had no idea what this payment form was. We’ve been using contactless mobile phone payment for a week in Saigon and never had a single issue anywhere - Covid has made everyone use this convenient payment method. 
We ended up paying in cash with a mix of USD and VND. 
Such a sour end to what was a pleasant evening. Completely unexpected and unnecessary attitude from the French owner/ management, and the opposite experience to what we’ve had at every other establishment during our time in Saigon.
